onscreen_lines.desc: 225kVA three-phase padmount transformer High side Voltage 12470/7200 - Low side voltage 120/208, deadfront, feed thru bushings, bayonet fusing, kVA and low side voltage stickers on the outside of the doors, NEMA standards, 200amp bushing well inserts, temperature gauge, and tap changer must be included.
